title: W&W Learn Electrical
tagline: A phone-first revision app for Phase 4 electrical apprentices.
description: A revision app for SOLAS Phase 4 electrical exams: quizzes, a Formula Lab, board drawings and two games, with accounts so progress follows the learner to any device.
longDescription:
Apprentices revising for the SOLAS Phase 4 electrical exams mostly study on their phones, in short bursts. This app is built for that.

- **Quizzes and flashcards** cover the exam questions, with feedback on every answer.
- **Formula Lab** generates practice calculations from 23 formulas, worked to 3 decimal places.
- **Board drawings** and tap-to-reveal diagrams help with the drawing questions.
- **Two games** (Snap and Block Drop) make revision of symbols and facts quicker.
- **Accessible by design:** read-aloud with word highlighting on all text, adjustable font, size, spacing, tint and a reading ruler, and 44 px+ tap targets.

### How it's built

React, Vite, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS, published from Lovable. All study content and logic run in the browser. Accounts and saved progress use Supabase Auth with row-level security, so each account can only read its own progress.

### Try it

Choose **Continue as guest** on the log-in page to use the full app without an account. Guest progress is lost when you close the tab.
